entrance_photo_registration.projection: Assume equally spaced equirectangular yaw. Column 1024 in the stitched strip corresponds to the seam of the original 4096-pixel panorama. Solve for a common panorama yaw offset and an unconstrained horizontal point using three camera positions and image marks. The position lies behind the frozen street face; transfer only its distance along that facade. An independent tagged 48 POI triangulates the same along-facade span. Three observations solve three unknowns; the residual itself does not provide an independent cross-check.
